newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul approves Yukong Gas, six other IPOs.
newsitem.headline: Seoul approves Yukong Gas, six other IPOs.

text.p: South Korea's Securities Exchange Commission said on Friday it had approved the initial public offerings of seven companies, including Yukong Gas Co.
Yukong Gas, which sells liquefied petroleum gas, plans to offer 2.40 million shares at 15,500 won per share, a statement from the commission said.
LG-Caltex Gas Co Ltd will offer 2.06 million shares at 16,500 won per share, Yoo Sung Metal Co Ltd, 273,000 shares at 11,000 won per share, and Pantech Co Ltd, 440,000 shares at 60,000 won per share.

The commission said Poong Sung Electric Co Ltd plans to offer 860,000 shares at 19,000 won per share, Daou Technology Inc, 480,000 shares at 48,000 won per share, and Younbo Chemical Co Ltd, 290,400 shares at 31,000 won per share.

The commission said public subscription for share offers by all seven companies would be on July 23-24, with payment due by August 7. The shares are expected to be listed in mid-August, it said. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
